Couldn\'t find BeamNG.drive. In the game enable Options → Controls → Hardware → “Use your phone or tablet”, and keep the phone on the same Wi-Fi.
Easiest is the Connect button — no code needed. Otherwise take a clear photo of the game\'s QR and read it here, or paste the link / type the 5-digit code if you already have it.
No QR found in that photo — take a closer, sharper shot of just the QR.
This page shows YOUR real values. Type them into the game exactly as written — no guessing, no copying from screenshots.
— connect the phone to Wi-Fi (or turn on its hotspot) and this page will fill it in —
Turn your phone into the steering wheel, gas and brake for the car in the game.
Connect your phone to the SAME Wi-Fi as your PC — the same home network / router. This is the one thing that must be right.
On your PC in BeamNG.drive: open Options → Controls → Hardware, find “Use your phone or tablet” and set it to Yes. A QR code appears — you can ignore it.
Come back to this app and tap the big CONNECT button. The first search can take 2–3 minutes on 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi; after that it connects in seconds. No QR, no typing.
Why not the QR: since v0.39 the game’s QR became too dense for most phone cameras to read. The Connect button skips the camera and finds the game over your Wi-Fi, so it works on any phone.
The Connect button works for almost everyone. If it can’t find the game (a few Wi-Fi networks block it), try one of these:
Tap Scan QR and point your phone’s camera at the QR on your PC screen. Hold the phone steady and fairly close — it connects on its own.
B · Read the QR from a photo
Take a clear, close photo of the QR on your PC screen. Then tap Enter code → READ QR FROM A PHOTO and choose that photo. The app reads it and connects.

Only if you already have the code. Where to find it: point ANY QR app — your normal phone camera or Google Lens — at the game’s QR. It opens a Google Play link that ends with “#12345”. Those last 5 digits ARE your code. Type them under Enter code.
Unlocks on the drive screen: live speed, RPM needle, gear, fuel, engine temperature, turbo boost, real warning lights (signals, high beam, handbrake, ABS, TC, oil, battery) and crash vibration.

Shows a live drift angle above the speedometer while you slide, plus your session record. Great with the 0-100 timer (enable it in the app\'s Settings).
In game: Options → Advanced → Protocols (same place)

Nothing arrives? Allow BeamNG.drive through the Windows Firewall.
Guest/hotel Wi-Fi often blocks phones from talking to PCs — use your own network or the phone\'s hotspot.
Router gave the phone a new IP? Re-check this page and update the game, then Ctrl+R.
Gauges frozen after a game update? Re-tick the options — settings occasionally reset.
No router? Turn on the phone\'s hotspot, connect the PC to it, and use the address shown at the top of this page.
Gauges stay empty in split-screen? The game switches its dashboard stream off while multi-seat is on.

On your PC, download remotecontrolpro_umutsevimcann.zip from the Releases page of this app on GitHub.
Move the zip, without extracting it, into the game\'s mods folder: AppData › Local › BeamNG › BeamNG.drive › current › mods
Start the game and tap Connect in this app. A MOD label on the drive screen shows the link is active.
Nothing in the game is replaced. To remove the mod, delete the zip. If the mod is not found, the app connects the usual way.
Above the pedals: tap to apply, tap again to release
A row under the gauges: lights, fog, signals, hazards, recover
A small add-on for the game. The app works without it; add it and the phone can do what the game\'s own phone remote cannot.
